title: The Controls window (F1), at its default place in the middle of the screen
head: a053fe294d91dc885bbb061c2f34d76ca6897738
geometry: derived from GameApp/Hud.cpp arithmetic by derive_layouts.py; not dumped from the game (no build in this container). Elements with measured:false depend on DirectWrite text measurement (ADR-061) and are estimated.
drawOrder: layer -1 (entity bars) first; then layer 0 (HUD) and each window layer back to front; within a layer every 'panels' element (panel/outline/bar/button) in order, then 'lines', then 'sprites', then 'texts' (Hud.h:714-760, GameClient.cpp:1289-1338).
notes: Map content is seed 342's, a sample (a match's seed is the clock, WinMain.cpp:134-139): the 7 sectors pirates guard at the start of every match, camps on the contested pairs D1/B5 and E2/A4 and strongholds on the rich pair E1/A5 and the center C3 (Map.json outposts; Map.cpp:421-440; ADR-072 d7, ADR-073); and all 40 ore asteroids, Map.json's 6 home ones and the 34 the seed places by Map.json sectorKinds and placement (Map.cpp:381-419), drawn under the fog since the map's asteroids are always seen (Simulation.cpp:245-247; Hud.cpp:3486-3528). A held sector shows its Relay on its node, and each rig the income implies stands on its asteroid.
